== Description ==
Original (2005) Players Committee slip of [[Evacuation Control (V) (Virtual Set 10: Fourth Anthology) (Original 2005)|Evacuation Control (V)]], as printed on the first [[Virtual Set 10: Fourth Anthology]] sheet (VirtualCards10.pdf, PDF created 17 July 2005), before the December 2006 Remaster. The printed label above the slip is included.

== Source and credit ==
* Source document: [[Media:Original_Virtual_Set_10_card_slips.pdf|Original Virtual Set 10 card slips.pdf]] ([[:File:Original Virtual Set 10 card slips.pdf|file page]]), PDF page 1, slip 2 (printed collector mark 10•2). The PDF (SHA-1 feacc109bec7f011c9da4a78de09c8f714e7d422) is the wiki copy of Players Committee forum attachment 16603 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16603 VirtualCards10.pdf]), posted by Throdo in [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1047092#p1047092 Original 17 VSet PDFs & Pre-Reset Block PDFs], 13 July 2016. Preserved copy of the post: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261124024945/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1047092.html Internet Archive].
* Derivation: PDF page 1 rendered at 300 dpi (poppler pdftoppm), the slip with its printed label cut out (pixel box 104,1358–862,1809 of the 2550 × 3300 render) and saved as PNG. Nothing else was changed.
* Publisher: the Players Committee, 2005. Original card imagery © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. Fair use: the image identifies the published card on this non-commercial fan wiki.
